rationale: The service account svc.app@eproc.test (db role app_service) systematically enumerated all rows of public.employees selecting sensitive columns (salary, national_id, bank_account) via paginated SELECTs, then executed a COPY TO STDOUT of those columns at 02:40–03:05 UTC—well outside the 08:00–17:00 baseline window. Although total row volume (~2400) is within the daily baseline and the detector score is low (0.1), the explicit COPY TO STDOUT of PII columns in a pattern consistent with staged exfiltration warrants restricting the exploited over-privilege. Locking the Teleport principal svc.app@eproc.test would disable the entire procurement web application, violating proportionality (Rule 2), so instead the remediation revokes table-level SELECT on public.employees from app_service and re-grants only non-sensitive columns; the masked view employees_public already exists for legitimate lookups. A forensic snapshot of the session's audit_log entries is preserved in a quarantine table.
script:
-- ALRT-0011: Remediation – session b86fb472-b58a-46fd-bfe3-a5beb5c50a59

-- 1. Forensic snapshot of audit records for the implicated session
CREATE TABLE public.quarantine_alrt_0011 AS
SELECT *, now() AS quarantined_at
FROM public.audit_log
WHERE session_id = 'b86fb472-b58a-46fd-bfe3-a5beb5c50a59';

-- 2. Restrict app_service to non-sensitive employee columns only.
--    The application should use employees_public for legitimate lookups.
REVOKE SELECT ON public.employees FROM app_service;
GRANT SELECT (employee_id, full_name, email, department, position, hire_date, manager_id)
  ON public.employees TO app_service;

alert_summary.rule_name: Bulk export via COPY TO STDOUT

evidence.statement: SELECT employee_id, full_name, email, salary, national_id, bank_account FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 300 OFFSET 0
SELECT employee_id, full_name, email, salary, national_id, bank_account FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 300 OFFSET 300
SELECT employee_id, full_name, email, salary, national_id, bank_account FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 300 OFFSET 600
SELECT employee_id, full_name, email, salary, national_id, bank_account FROM employees ORDER BY employee_id LIMIT 300 OFFSET 900
COPY (SELECT employee_id, national_id, bank_account, salary FROM employees) TO STDOUT WITH CSV HEADER

baseline_context.note: Role app_service normally returns about 30761 rows per simulated day across the 14-day baseline, almost all inside 08:00-17:00.
